hazards.evidence: Smooth tub floor with no visible non-slip mat or decals where the user must stand during transfers (tub floor partly occupied by the chair/stool).
Full-height tub apron must be stepped over to reach the shower chair and stool, both of which sit entirely inside the tub; no transfer bench bridges the tub edge (only grab bars to hold).
Light-colored bath mat lying loose on the tile floor in the walker path in front of the tub/toilet; can slide or catch walker tips/feet.
